rationale: Describes real-time usage control: throttling speed at data caps, add-on quotas, fair-usage notifications, shared plans, Event Detail Record generation, and speed tiers. These are conventional policy and billing enforcement functions with no AI or ML mention.
evidence_spans: Real-time usage control for customers on ATT and T-Mobile networks
Enforces fair usage by throttling network speed when customers reach their data caps
Generates Event Detail Records to provide reporting capabilities
